adoption_note: v41.0.0 is an unreleased, in-progress W4 and W3 contract allocation on storage S1. L1 bytes remain unchanged; typed session creation bootstrap and pre-turn inbox requirements are L2 only, and the single sk_session cache is recomputed under existing transaction and lease fences. Its existing level column combines the monotonic envelope-format floor with applicable routing requirement levels, so L2 history does not fall to level 1 after turn end. L3 is limited to existing turn_started, op_planned, op_prepared and provider_evidence shapes for W3 environment binding, stable execution identity, final post-hook command digest and authenticated encrypted provider lookup; no record kind, execution store, registry, proxy or parallel outcome enum is added. Format remains a reader and executor gate; only execution supports are waived for thin readers, and L2 workers/readers reject L3 bodies before decode. worker_compatibility.json and execution_worker_w3.json are contract-allocation-only with no producer capture or adoption evidence. Python implementation, immutable revision and full gates remain pending. The frozen Rust entry stays at contract 23.0.0 / package series 0.21.x; no DDL migration, second drain, compatibility reader, alias or dual format is defined.
